title: A local path into Pollinations MCP
summary:
Local MCP setup got simpler, four community projects joined the directory, and Mistral traffic took a new route.

The MCP server was reorganized around STDIO for local clients, with an `npx` setup path and a `pollinations-mcp` CLI entry point. Assistant instructions and image, text, audio, and resource services were revised alongside a session-based GitHub sign-in service.

The Creative Apps directory added @Auspicious14’s PollinateAI for visual design inspiration and @sizzlebop’s Dreamscape AI, which combines image generation and styling with chat, voice chat, and research tools.

The project listings added @mkantwala’s CoNavic browser extension for natural-language tab and bookmark controls, plus @CiaranMcAleer’s Mimir AIP framework for AI pipelines with Pollinations provider support.

highlights.title: MCP for local clients
highlights.text: Run the Pollinations MCP server through `npx` or the `pollinations-mcp` CLI entry point, using STDIO to connect a local client. [MCP server docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs#tag/mcp-servers).
